main_makhana.descriptionHtml_full:
Buy Premium Mithila Makhana Online in India

Shop GrassCrafts Premium Makhana, also known as phool makhana, fox nuts or lotus seeds, sourced from the Mithila region of Bihar, India. These traditional lotus seeds are sun-dried and packed plain for you to roast, season and enjoy your way.

Why choose GrassCrafts makhana?

  • Plain and simple: no added oil, salt, sugar or preservatives.
  • Versatile snack: roast at home, add your favourite seasoning, or use in kheer and curries.
  • Traditional Mithila sourcing: from the Mithila region of Bihar.
  • Resealable, food-safe pouch: helps keep the product stored neatly after opening.
  • Retail and gifting: suitable for home pantries, festive hampers, wedding gifts and corporate gifting enquiries.

Choose your makhana pack size

Available in 250 g, 500 g and 1 kg pack options. Check the selection and current price above before ordering. We offer delivery across India; shipping charges and eligibility are shown at checkout.

How to prepare and store makhana

Dry-roast over low heat for around 5–8 minutes until crisp, or prepare with your preferred seasoning. Store in a cool, dry place and reseal the pouch after opening. Best before 6 months from the date of packaging.

Bulk, wholesale and corporate gifting

Looking to buy makhana in bulk for retail, festive hampers, weddings or corporate gifts? Contact GrassCrafts for a quote through our wholesale and corporate gifting page or WhatsApp +91 62907 44782.

Find Makhana by GrassCrafts on Google Maps for business details and customer reviews.
